Name: Eidolon
Description: During a time when Wiccan and Hulkling were questioning whether they were going to stay in space or begin to visit Earth more, Agatha Harkness decided to secretly test Wiccan's abilities, unbeknownst to the boys. Eidolon first appeared as the boyfriend of Wiccan in a dream-like pocket dimension. Wiccan appeared to be unaware of any changes and did not remember Hulkling, or any of the other previous events in his life.
